the_last_field: Last field. No one came. I took a stone off a dead man and held it. It read. I know the name.
the_name: {name}. I said it once over a dying man and did not write it. I write it now.
three_winters: Three winters. I gave the long words to every dying man I found, and in time they came back to me. Something was wrong with the short rite. I do not know what.
biome:the_battlefield: Never cleared. The dead lie where they fell. I said the short words over men like these. Perhaps these.
biome:rot_swamp: The mud takes a man's legs and keeps them. Chests in the reeds, drowned. Only black water inside.
biome:chapel_ruins: One of our chapels. Deserters broke it at the end, they say. I was taught the rite in a house like this, and the dead walk its nave.
biome:ashen_forest: Old pyres under the black trees. Someone burned their dead here, as it should be done. The wood never stopped burning after.
biome:frozen_pass: Ice and cairns. Men bring silver down from here, and some do not come down. The ice tombs are open. The ice kept nothing.
village_first: {name}. A wall of stakes, a well, a fire. I have not slept inside a wall in a long time.
village: {name}. A wall, a well, a fire. They looked at my blade before my face.
{name}. They burn their dead here. The smoke hangs in the lanes.
{name}. Fewer of them than the last place. The wall leans.
{name}. No one asked my name. I did not give it.
search_first: I search the dead now. Once I knelt by them. A helm off a man I may have shriven. He did not need it.
hollow_first: Laid one down. Dead man's mail, dead man's face, and a spear. The field will stand another up by morning.
bind_first: The empty stone took it. The Hollow fell and did not get up, and the stone glows now. I laid him to rest, I think. I said no name.
read_first: The stone spoke. A few words, and then the same words again. A track, the Order taught. A man would answer. A stone repeats.
talk_first: I offered the long words for their dead. They have their own monk. They would not have a stranger, and they are right.
talk_monk_first: A brother of the Order, or what is left of one. He has the long words. He did not ask where I served, and I did not tell him.
talk_guard_first: An old soldier on the gate. He looked at my blade, then at my hands. Keep it low inside the walls, he said.
barter_first: Metal by weight, and every coin nicked. Bright inside is weighed. Grey inside is scrap, like the marks they paid me in.
carve_first: I cut a notch in the edge and fed it shards. The cracks filled with light. A lamp takes oil. A relic takes shards. So I tell myself.
fuse_first: Two relics pressed into one stone. Two tracks running the same way now. The Order never taught this.
utter_first: I spoke a stone through the blade, the way the war spoke thousands. It burned like a wick and broke into shards. Then the ground opened and something climbed out, burning at the seams. It had no name left to call.
rite_ennick: Their ledger keeps their own dead. I found his count in it and wrote the name beside it. What is written is not lost.
rite_gled: I gave what he held to their fire. It burned like anything burns. He let go of it. The fire asks only that.
rite_wend: I left him by the road, and he went. The stone was only a stone after. I felt lighter, and I did not earn it.
rite_hush: He wanted to rest unnamed, so I scraped the name out of the ledger. A kindness. I cannot remember whose it was.
rite_grudge: I banked the coal over him. He was so angry, and I let him keep it. That night the guards stood double at the gate.
rite_mortmain: I laid him in the niche and the grate came down. He is safe there. I can see the stone from the road.
crimson_first: Red. I know every grade a gleaner sorts, and not this one. It weeps at the cracks like a wound that will not close.
death_first: I fell. There was a road, and someone walked me back along it to a gate. Wend walks the dead home. Not back.
death: Fell again. The road turned me round again.
Woke by the gate. Wend has little left to spend, and she spends it on me.
Down, and back. I do not know how many more times the road will have me.
The road again. Someone keeps walking me home.
death_whisper: Fell. I came back quickly, as if someone wanted me back. One of my stones is quiet now. It was tired.
Down, and back at once. They are good to me. Something I carried is quieter.
whisper: Slept well. The stones are good company at night. Perhaps the short rite was a mercy. They went quickly.
Quiet tonight. The fire is warm and the stones are warm. Nothing on the road needs me.
I have been too hard on the short rite. It was quick, and quick is kind.
whisper_leave: I read back what I wrote these last days. It is my hand. I do not know whose words.
pull: Hungry. The words are on the page. I cannot read them.
The colour going again. I know this road. I walked it three winters.
Hands. Will not hold the pen. Kneel.
